snippet.title: mimicrune: TENSE PLAYTEST | Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The first properly somewhat kind of playable public playtest for Mimicrune!
Boots you directly into the first (mini)boss of the game, a Tense Battle against a twisted Prototype and Celebracean.

A few important notes:
- There may be some missing or outdated animations present- please ignore them! I'm mostly doing all of this solo, so it takes me time to get around to them. Most notably are Evan's item, magic, and victory animations- though I'm sure I missed a few others.
- There are almost certainly gamebreaking bugs or glitches- please report them if you find them :]
- You can press 'V' to parry if Evan is not downed. This would usually be taught to you, but that tutorial is long before this encounter... not all attacks are parryable, however. As a hint- in this specific playtest, only things that **can already be reflected** are parryable.

Good luck, and have fun!

---

If you want to follow the project more closely or contribute to its development, feel free to join the discord.
https://discord.gg/rKdKaU4dVV

Or check it out on Game Jolt!
https://gamejolt.com/games/mimicrune/1017124
